commands.speaker: or_volunteer
commands.text: If we put everything close to the bench, the next group can reach it.

commands.speaker: nara_vell
commands.text: And if the boxes close the approach, they cannot reach the bench.

commands.speaker: marek_vane
commands.text: We need an order that works when the two of us have gone ahead.

commands.speaker: or_volunteer
commands.text: I thought keeping you here was the safer plan.

commands.speaker: nara_vell
commands.text: A useful place should not depend on one pair of shoulders.
Marek sets his spear beside the supply board. He does not start a marching song.
